title: Surigao town's ‘arm-to-spoon’ program among 2026 Galing Pook awardees

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — The coastal municipality of Del Carmen on Siargao Island, Surigao del Norte, earned national acclaim after its flagship food security and climate-adaptation program, “Farm-to-Spoon,” was named one of the 10 outstanding local governance programs at the 2026 Galing Pook Awards. President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. conferred the awards on municipal leaders in a ceremony at Malacañang Palace on Wednesday, Oct. 21. Del Carmen emerged as a recipient of the award after a rigorous screening process involving a nationwide pool of 208 program submissions from 148 local government units.
